_help: Edit the prompt templates and rules here. Placeholders: {article} {ethnicity} {person} {gender} {clothing}. {person} is the age+gender phrase from 'person' below. Lookups that depend on gender use the gender's CLASS (see gender_class), so androgyne uses the female wording for age words and clothing.

ethnicities._help: file tag : word used in the prompt. 'All' uses this list. Add new groups here, or just type a new name when you run the tool.

street.template: Sci-fi setting. Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of a content {ethnicity} {person} with an sleeveless shirt and a jacket. The background is a sci-fi street at night.

hydroponic.template: Sci-fi setting. Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of a content {ethnicity} {person} with {clothing}. The background is a lavish hydroponic garden.

uniform.template: Frontal close-up passport photo of the face of {article} {ethnicity} {person} with an olive Peaked Cap with a red star on it and a Soviet style uniform. The background is futuristic, but with no windows.
